def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    
    # Convert text numbers to numeric
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    
    # Fix sex label variants (strip spaces)
    if df['sex'].dtype == 'object':
        df['sex'] = df['sex'].str.strip()
    
    # Filter out out_of_range body_mass_g values (should be 2500-6500)
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)]
    
    # Filter out out_of_range flipper_length_mm values (should be 170-235)
    df = df[(df['flipper_length_mm'] >= 170) & (df['flipper_length_mm'] <= 235)]
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Group by species and calculate average body mass
    result = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean().round(2).to_dict()
    return result
